source_counts.limitation: One seed and reused development validation; this is not a causal proof. New and matched arms share initialization, old fit-only scaler, per-epoch instances and maximum budget. Independent early stopping can change best and actual total updates. Distinct document coverage and example weights still differ. The new96 validation documents are calibration/development data, never an independent confirmation. Previously inspected C4 or natural tests are not read or reused; a promoted candidate needs new independent confirmation.

interpretation: New-long-tail development ranking and five-way accuracy improve, while natural system precision and old long-tail system F1 regress; the result is a tradeoff, not a promoted model.
Old-natural system TP=662/FN=0 for original and new-maximin; false positives rise from 26 to114. The natural failure is precision, despite near-perfect AUROC/BAcc.

Long-full training instance share rises from 29.23% to54.83% in both augmentation arms, with zero natural fit examples in either arm. Source diversity and weighting cannot be separated causally by this result alone.
The two arms match per-epoch instance count and maximum budget, but independent early stopping produces different best and actual total updates; do not claim actual-step matching.
Matched-maximin diagnostic min24 exceeds90%, but it fails retention/no-fallback criteria and is not an eligible promoted replacement. Reused validation does not establish fresh-test generalization.

prospective_natural_fitmix_plan.objective: Add genuinely prepared natural SUA training support, which current densefit entirely lacks; isolate this change from long-source upweighting.
prospective_natural_fitmix_plan.source_selection: Use exactly cached eligible_fit=True 255 conversations and eligible_clean_validation=True 64. Exclude the complete one contaminated fit conversation, preserve original sample_ix and source IDs; no replacement.

proposed_features.method: New separate metadata-only declaration/source signature before GPU; exactly four A40 native frozen MXFP4 forward, eight ranked pre-o_proj heads only, no legacy captures, no LM training.
proposed_features.integrity: Bind natural protocol/cache/ledger/duplicate hashes, tokenizer/config/weight manifests, head rank/old scaler and extractor source; local cache_ix plus original sample_ix; >=512MiB reserve; NaN/prefix/byte-hash restart, disabled-write bitexact and saved-F16 portable parity. Do not alter old banks.

minimal_training_pair.architecture: Existing pointwise MLP128, unchanged original fit-only 512-scaler; same initial seed, optimizer and early-stopping rule. Training protocol must be frozen separately before use.
minimal_training_pair.treatment: 578090 original densefit C4 rows plus each of the 63403 eligible natural fit tokens exactly once per epoch.
minimal_training_pair.matched_control: Same per-epoch instances/updates and maximum budget; replace the 63403 natural instances by a predeclared deterministic sample from original C4 fit only. Both arms retain the original 578090 rows.
minimal_training_pair.roles: Retain all five C4 roles and normal SUA natural roles. Public natural CoT/tool have zero support/N/A; never relabel assistant replies as CoT/tool.
minimal_training_pair.early_stopping: Freeze best epoch using the same original old-five validation helper for both arms; only after best checkpoints are fixed, evaluate/calibrate on the predeclared development groups.
minimal_training_pair.validation: Keep all 64 clean natural conversations entirely out of optimizer and scaler. Treat their 16 families/dependency components as development, not an independent test. Reuse original old-five/old-tail and new-long96/full-tail as development; no test probabilities.
minimal_training_pair.selection: Before any new training fix the global F32-consumer threshold objective and retention guards against unchanged old control and matched control; publish both negative and positive arms. No per-profile threshold or test-driven fallback.

prospective_natural_fitmix_plan.parallel_multiseed: Use the root separately frozen a1ad395c345ec8af91d5782987a95f0b9cd9034da92b7f40debc2dce1ec521e6 design: three new seeds 20261022/23/24 plus original 20261021, fixed equal four-model probability mean, original 578090 fit/scaler, full old CPU/GPU-saved drift controls. This proposal does not change that design.
prospective_natural_fitmix_plan.confirmation: No currently seen C4/natural test may select a model or threshold. Fresh natural128 sources are not yet selected/materialized in this round; any new independent confirmation requires another frozen protocol.
limitations: Public assistant replies are OASST human or recorded ToxicChat/Vicuna replies, not GPT-OSS-120B generation under newly assigned system instructions.
255 fit conversations have 32 system wording families; 64 validation conversations have 16 families/components, not 64 independent system stimuli.
SUA augmentation may improve natural system false positives; it supplies no genuine CoT/tool training supervision and does not guarantee 90% on fresh long documents.
